title: make flowchart elk detector regex match less greedy
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Makes the flowchart elk detector less greedy. Having it without group match will detect diagram type incorrectly and will not allow to have char sequence 'graph' in any diagram type as described in #6795

Resolves #6795

author: HashanCP

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The original regex `/^\s*flowchart|graph/` was incorrectly structured - it matches 'flowchart' at the start OR 'graph' anywhere in the string due to operator precedence. The fix correctly groups the alternatives with parentheses to match either 'flowchart' or 'graph' at the beginning of the string.

thread.actionability_reasoning: This comment explains and validates the fix already made in the PR — it describes what the original bug was and confirms the new code is correct. It does not suggest any further code change.
